standard_prerequisites.name: The derived pushforward along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism commutes with direct sums on complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends the assertion from single complexes to direct sums.

standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine base the tilde functor is an equivalence between D(A) and D_QCoh, and the P-resolution remark reduces assertions stable under direct sums and triangles to free modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assertion to the shifts A[k] of the structure sheaf.

core_obligations: Localize on Y and reduce to Y affine, since the assertion is local (proof lines 5284-5286).

Stability lemmas: if K is a direct sum of K_i and the assertion holds for each K_i, it holds for K because Lf^* and tensor preserve direct sums and Rf_* commutes with direct sums by the pushforward direct sums lemma; if K -> L -> M -> K[1] is a distinguished triangle and the assertion holds for two terms, it holds for the third by exactness of the functors (proof lines 5288-5298).

Affine conclusion: via the equivalence D(A) = D_QCoh(O_Y) define the property T on D(A); the stability lemmas and the P-resolution remark show it suffices to prove T for A[k], where the projection formula map is tautologically an isomorphism (proof lines 5300-5310).
proof_roadmap: Establish stability under direct sums and distinguished triangles (proof lines 5288-5298).
Conclude via the P-resolution reduction to shifts of the structure sheaf (proof lines 5300-5310).
